summary: Snapshot and scope verified. Controller checks passed: 26 focused and 960 total; independent focused rerun passed using in-memory capture. No product defect found, but one required exception-path test guard is ineffective.

issues.description: test_sentinel_first_whole_tree leaves extract_proof_subtree uninstrumented, so its call-log assertions cannot detect extraction after the initial T0014 failure. An independent in-memory mutation performed that extra extraction and rethrew the original exception; this test still passed. This misses the explicit Group C/A5 requirement to verify that no subsequent dependency calls occur.
issues.required_change: Install a recording extraction spy in this test, restore both dependency bindings in finally, and assert that the combined call log contains only the initial canonical_motif_key call.
issues.validation: The original implementation must pass the revised test; an injected extraction after the first T0014 failure must fail it. Rerun both published focused and full checks without skips or xfails.
